query:
UPDATE duplicate_fingerprints 
                        SET content_hash = ?,
                            file_size = ?,
                            perceptual_hash = ?,
                            block_hash = ?,
                            thumb_hash = ?,
                            width = COALESCE(?, width),
                            height = COALESCE(?, height),
                            fingerprint_version = 4,
                            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        WHERE asset_id = ?
